source_backbone: Kew POWO/WCVP 2026, IPNI, Flora of Florida (2026) taxonomic key
synonym_and_rank_caution: Historical C. laxum subsp. sessiliflorum and var. sessiliflorum are homotypic synonyms of accepted C. sessiliflorum, not evidence to merge that species with accepted C. laxum. Uniola genus alone cannot determine destination.
native_range_audit: DEFERRED — NOT REVIEWED; no native/county fields changed
photo_and_specimen_identity: HOLD — botanical name verification does not verify source photo or specimen determinations
hybrid_provenance: HOLD — no individual hybrid parentage or cultivar identity established
install_decision: Existing canonical C. latifolium only; no new installations or changes to sibling species

decisions.subject: Chasmanthium latifolium (Michx.) H.O.Yates
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain accepted Poaceae species at species rank
decisions.detail: Kew WCVP accepts this combination, published S.W. Naturalist 11:416 (1966); canonical species name already matches.

decisions.subject: Uniola latifolia Michx.
decisions.proposed_decision: Map homotypic basionym to Chasmanthium latifolium; retain as searchable alias, not a new card
decisions.detail: Published 1803; only POWO synonym directly under C. latifolium.

decisions.subject: Chasmanthium laxum (L.) H.O.Yates
decisions.proposed_decision: Maintain separately accepted species; not a synonym of C. latifolium
decisions.detail: Accepted at species rank under POWO/WCVP; no installation implied.

decisions.subject: Holcus laxus L.
decisions.proposed_decision: Map homotypic basionym to C. laxum, not C. latifolium

decisions.subject: Uniola laxa (L.) Britton, Sterns & Poggenb.
decisions.proposed_decision: Map homotypic name to C. laxum
decisions.detail: Historic Uniola combination is not inland sea oats.

decisions.subject: Chasmanthium sessiliflorum (Poir.) Yates
decisions.proposed_decision: Maintain separately accepted species under POWO/WCVP
decisions.detail: POWO recognizes distinct species, published S.W. Naturalist 11:426 (1966).

decisions.subject: Uniola sessiliflora Poir.
decisions.proposed_decision: Map homotypic basionym to C. sessiliflorum, not C. latifolium

decisions.subject: Chasmanthium laxum subsp. sessiliflorum (Poir.) L.G.Clark
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical subspecies-rank combination to accepted C. sessiliflorum species
decisions.detail: POWO homotypic synonym; preserve original rank and author for historic observations.

decisions.subject: Chasmanthium laxum var. sessiliflorum (Poir.) Wipff & S.D.Jones
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety-rank combination to accepted C. sessiliflorum species

decisions.subject: Uniola longifolia Scribn.
decisions.proposed_decision: Map heterotypic synonym to accepted C. sessiliflorum, not to C. latifolium
decisions.detail: POWO records Uniola longifolia as heterotypic synonym of C. sessiliflorum.

decisions.subject: Automatically collapse C. sessiliflorum into C. laxum
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject automatic species merger under current POWO/WCVP accepted backbone
decisions.detail: Historic subspecies/variety combinations do not mean currently accepted species are synonymous.

decisions.subject: Automatically map all Uniola or Chasmanthium historical names to inland sea oats
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject name-only genus matching and preserve species-specific synonym destinations
decisions.detail: Uniola latifolia maps to latifolium, Uniola laxa to laxum, Uniola sessiliflora and U. longifolia to sessiliflorum.

decisions.subject: Species determination of C. latifolium gallery photographs and C. laxum / C. sessiliflorum comparison images
decisions.proposed_decision: Keep individual image and historical source-ID verification separate from accepted-name review
decisions.detail: Existing comparison photo rank/identity caution retained; no photographs examined or relabeled in taxonomy-only run.

decisions.subject: Unverified hybrid ancestry or cultivated-origin identity of individual Chasmanthium observations
decisions.proposed_decision: Do not infer a hybrid from appearance, label, or general possibility without accession-specific evidence
decisions.detail: No specimen-specific hybrid parentage or cultivar provenance established in this review; preserve any existing hold.

decisions.subject: Historical C. laxum infraspecific circumscription versus accepted C. sessiliflorum species
decisions.proposed_decision: Document competing historical rank treatments without collapsing accepted WCVP species boundaries
decisions.detail: POWO synonymy preserves historical subsp./var. sessiliflorum under laxum; contemporary Kew and Flora of Florida 2026 recognize separate species.

decisions.subject: Original 1803 Uniola latifolia page citation discrepancy
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain the name mapping; defer bibliographic collation check against the original protologue
decisions.detail: POWO cites Flora Boreali-Americana 1:71, while IPNI primary display gives 1:70 and a duplicate alternative 1:71. No change to accepted name or basionym.

scope_exclusions: No media/photo sourcing or photo relabeling
No Pages or workflow schedule changes
